WeReno is the AI operating layer for property improvement.

We spent more than a decade representing property owners, coordinating contractors, and managing renovations and capital projects. Across that time, we’ve helped facilitate $1B+ in project value and turned that operating playbook into AI agents that help property owners and contractors get work done.

Capital by WeReno manages complex commercial projects. Handyman.ai helps homeowners handle everyday repairs and maintenance. Renobot.ai represents homeowners through renovations. Opsonic.ai gives contractors an AI back office for quoting, scheduling, follow-up, and operations.

long_description.before:
RiskCube is building the first AI-native reinsurer for emerging risks.

Today, we operate an insurance brokerage focused on startups in AI, robotics, space, and defense. Through the brokerage, we see firsthand where traditional insurance products fail, from AI liability and autonomous systems to defense technology and new space risks.

We are now building proprietary risk models that can price risks even when little historical claims data exists. Our approach uses stochastic simulation, then applies traditional, explainable models to make the output transparent to underwriters and regulators.

This allows us to create new insurance and reinsurance products for emerging industries much faster than traditional carriers.

The U.S. insurance market still relies heavily on foreign reinsurance capacity.
Our goal is to build new reinsurance capacity on American soil for the industries defining the next generation of the U.S. economy, while reducing America's dependence on foreign reinsurance capacity.

long_description.before: AI models are terrible in non-English languages because it's nearly impossible to find training data in other languages. So, we're building the world's largest and highest-quality multilingual data library.
long_description.after: Mundo develops data, evaluations, and applied research for frontier labs and AI companies to advance perceptual intelligence across audio, video, and emerging modalities.

long_description.before: Norra helps nursing facilities manage equipment operations. Every year, ~$80 billion are spent on medical equipment like beds, concentrators, and wheelchairs. Nursing facilities continue to operate with zero visibility which leads to $15 billion in equipment waste annually. We use physical trackers and AI agents to eliminate this.
long_description.after: Norra tackles the operational chaos inside skilled nursing facilities, starting with equipment. We track every bed, wheelchair, and oxygen concentrator a facility owns, and use AI to tell operators what they have, where it is, and where money is leaking.

one_liner.before: Automating equipment operations for nursing facilities
one_liner.after: The AI equipment manager for post-acute care

long_description.before: Creating the largest patient-derived cancer single-cell dataset for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. These datasets are unique as they screen the effects of various drugs and genetic medicines under the control of our DNA switches.
long_description.after: Creating rich patient-derived cancer datasets for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. Our data comprises matched spatial transcriptomics, H&E and clinical labels. We operate our own laboratory, where samples are processed. Samples are sourced from leading biobank / hospital networks.
